mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tbl_attempt_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY session_id DESC

SELECT ad.attempt_id, ad.session_id, ad.problem_id, ad.selected_choice_id, (CASE WHEN ad.selected_choice_id = pc.choice_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_correct FROM tbl_attempt_details ad LEFT JOIN tbl_problem_choices pc ON ad.problem_id = pc.problem_id AND pc.is_correct = 1 WHERE ad.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY ad.problem_id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(times), 0) FROM tbl_attempt_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
